Furthermore, the tumor exhibits a sharp transition zone on FLAIR, which is characteristic of IDH-wildtype gliomas, as opposed to the more infiltrative, ill-defined borders of IDH-mutant astrocytomas. The absence of a T2-FLAIR mismatch also strongly argues against an IDH-mutant astrocytoma. There are no contradicting features.

These aggressive features are the antithesis of the typical radiological presentation of a 1p/19q co-deleted glioma. Therefore, a non-codeleted status is predicted with high confidence.
